questions.question: systemd, systemctl va journalctl farqi nima? ("systemctl vs systemd")
questions.explanation: systemd — init tizimi va servis menejeri (PID 1). systemctl — unga buyruq beradigan CLI. journalctl — systemd-journald loglarini o'qiydigan CLI.

questions.question: `systemctl start` va `systemctl enable` farqi? `--now` nima?
questions.explanation: start — hozir ishga tushiradi (reboot'dan keyin yo'q). enable — boot'da avtomatik (symlink yaratadi), hozir ishga tushirmaydi. `enable --now` — ikkalasi.

questions.question: `restart` va `reload` farqi? `reload-or-restart` qachon?
questions.explanation: restart — jarayon o'ldiriladi va qayta ko'tariladi (ulanishlar uziladi). reload — jarayon tirik, faqat config qayta o'qiladi (odatda SIGHUP), unit'da ExecReload bo'lsa.

questions.question: `systemctl daemon-reload` nima va qachon kerak?
questions.explanation: Unit fayllar (.service) diskda o'zgarganda systemd'ga ularni qayta o'qitadi. Servisni restart qilmaydi.

questions.question: Servis ishlamayapti. Birinchi qaysi buyruqlar?
questions.explanation: `systemctl status app` -> `journalctl -u app -e` / `-b` -> unit faylni ko'r (`systemctl cat app`) -> qo'lda ishga tushirib ko'r.

questions.question: crontab sintaksisi: `*/5 * * * *` nima? `crontab -e/-l` va `/etc/crontab` farqi?
questions.explanation: 5 maydon: daqiqa soat kun oy hafta_kuni. */5 — har 5 daqiqada. crontab -e — user crontab'i; /etc/crontab va /etc/cron.d/* — tizim, 6-maydon user nomi.

questions.question: `cron`, `anacron` va systemd timer farqi?
questions.explanation: cron — aniq vaqtda ishlaydi, server o'chiq bo'lsa o'tkazib yuboradi. anacron — kunlik/haftalik ishlarni server yoqilganda bajarib qo'yadi (laptop, vaqti-vaqti bilan o'chadigan server). systemd timer — ikkalasining imkoniyati: `Persistent=true`, log journald'da, bog'liqliklar.

questions.question: O'z ilovang uchun systemd unit fayl yoz (Go binary, alohida user, auto-restart).
questions.explanation: `/etc/systemd/system/app.service`: [Unit] After/Wants, [Service] User, ExecStart, Restart=on-failure, Environment, limits; [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target.

questions.question: Unit `Type=` qiymatlari: simple, exec, forking, oneshot, notify — farqi?
questions.explanation: systemd servis qachon "tayyor" deb hisoblashini belgilaydi. simple — darhol; exec — exec() muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgach; forking — ota jarayon chiqqach; oneshot — tugagach; notify — ilova sd_notify(READY=1) yuborganda.

questions.question: `Restart=` qiymatlari va `StartLimitBurst`/`StartLimitIntervalSec` nima?
questions.explanation: Restart=no/on-failure/always/on-abnormal... servis o'lganda qayta ishga tushirish siyosati. StartLimit — ma'lum vaqtda N martadan ko'p restart bo'lsa systemd taslim bo'ladi (start-limit-hit).

questions.question: `Wants`, `Requires`, `After`, `Before`, `BindsTo` farqi?
questions.explanation: Wants/Requires — dependency (nimani birga ishga tushirish); After/Before — tartib (ordering). Ular mustaqil: Requires=X tartib bermaydi, After=X ham kerak.

questions.question: Paket bergan unit faylni qanday to'g'ri o'zgartirasan? (drop-in, `systemctl edit`)
questions.explanation: `systemctl edit nginx` — `/etc/systemd/system/nginx.service.d/override.conf` yaratadi; paket yangilanganda yo'qolmaydi. To'liq almashtirish: `systemctl edit --full`.

questions.question: journalctl'ning eng kerakli flaglari?
questions.explanation: -u unit, -f follow, -e end, -b boot, --since/--until, -p priority, -o format, -k kernel, --disk-usage, --vacuum-*.

questions.question: journald disk to'ldiryapti. Qanday cheklaysan?
questions.explanation: `/etc/systemd/journald.conf`: SystemMaxUse=, SystemKeepFree=, MaxRetentionSec=; restart journald; bir martalik tozalash `journalctl --vacuum-size`.

questions.question: systemd timer va cron farqi? Timer qanday yoziladi?
questions.explanation: cron — oddiy, klassik. timer — unit bilan birlashgan: log journald'da, dependency, Persistent= (o'tkazib yuborilganini bajaradi), RandomizedDelaySec, resource limit.

questions.question: Cron job qo'lda ishlaydi, cron'da ishlamaydi. Sabablari?
questions.explanation: Environment farqi: PATH, HOME, shell (sh, bash emas), working directory, `%` belgisi, ruxsat, ssh-agent/credentials yo'q, crontab oxirida newline yo'q.

questions.question: systemd'da servisni resurs bilan cheklash (CPU, RAM, IO) va hardening qanday?
questions.explanation: cgroup v2 asosida: MemoryMax, MemoryHigh, CPUQuota, CPUWeight, IOWeight, TasksMax. Hardening: NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem, ProtectHome, PrivateTmp, CapabilityBoundingSet, SystemCallFilter. Baho: `systemd-analyze security`.

questions.question: Graceful shutdown: `systemctl stop` paytida nima sodir bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: systemd ExecStop (bo'lsa) bajaradi, so'ng KillSignal (SIGTERM) cgroup'dagi jarayonlarga, TimeoutStopSec kutadi, keyin SIGKILL. KillMode= kimga yuborilishini belgilaydi.

questions.question: Socket activation va `systemd-analyze` vositalari nima beradi?
questions.explanation: Socket activation: systemd portni o'zi ochadi, birinchi ulanishda servisni ko'taradi; restart paytida ulanishlar navbatda kutadi. systemd-analyze — boot vaqti, critical-chain, unit tekshiruvi, security.

questions.question: Servis restart-loop'da (crash -> restart -> crash). Qanday tahlil qilasan?
questions.explanation: `systemctl status` (restart counter, exit code/signal), `journalctl -u app -b --no-pager` birinchi xatoni top (oxirgisi emas), exit code ma'nosini aniqla (1 config, 203 EXEC, 137 OOM, 139 SIGSEGV), coredump (`coredumpctl`), qo'lda shu user/env bilan ishga tushir, so'nggi o'zgarish (deploy/config/secret).

questions.question: journald yoki ilova loglarida vaqt mos kelmaydi / boot oralig'ida loglar yo'qolgan. Nima sabab?
questions.explanation: Journal volatile (`/run/log/journal`, reboot'da yo'qoladi) — `Storage=persistent` yoki `/var/log/journal` yarat. Rate limit (`Suppressed N messages`). Vaqt: soat sinxron emas yoki timezone farqi (UTC vs local). Crash oldidagi loglar diskka flush bo'lmagan.
